description: Navigate a phone menu: press keys (DTMF) on a connected call you hold, e.g. "1" or "2w123#" (w = half-second pause). Set sensitive for PINs or account numbers: your owner's ledger shows them masked.

digits.description: Keys to press: 0-9 * # A-D, w/W to pause

name: ordan.call.dtmf
title: Press keys on a call
